verdict.rationale: The evidence covers basic ingestion only: thread.add_messages ingests chat messages into the Context Graph, and JSON, text, and message data can be ingested. Nothing in the pack documents batch ingestion, asynchronous or background processing, or any way to check the status of memory operations. zepctl's vague mention of managing 'data operations' does not establish batch or status-tracking capability, and an absent but applicable capability is 'none'.
